entities.summary: Fernando Martín Menis, better known as Fernando Menis, is a Spanish architect. He graduated from the Barcelona Institute of Architecture. He serves as the Chairman of the Laboratory for Innovation in Architecture, Design and Advanced Tourism of Tenerife. He is also a professor at the European University of the Canary Islands (EUC) and, occasionally, serves as a guest speaker at International Congresses of Architecture and Universities.
